previous_sql: SELECT c.customer_sk, m.merchant_sk FROM dim_customer AS c, dim_merchant AS m LIMIT 100
question: enséñame clientes y comercios juntos
sql: SELECT c.customer_sk, m.merchant_sk FROM dim_customer AS c JOIN fact_payment_attempt AS f ON c.customer_sk = f.customer_sk JOIN dim_merchant AS m ON m.merchant_sk = f.merchant_sk GROUP BY c.customer_sk, m.merchant_sk ORDER BY c.customer_sk, m.merchant_sk LIMIT 100
